note: ESI AS PER GOVERNMENT RULES — applied at payroll close to every ESI-eligible employee when the Salary structure sets NO ESI rule for them (owner, 16 Oct 2026: 'If nothing is set for ESIC, consider it as per Government rules'). A Salary structure ESI rule, or ESI switched off on the employee, always wins. Change the law here, not in PHP.
law: ESI Act 1948 / Code on Social Security 2020 Ch. IV; ESI (Central) Rules r.50-51
daily_wage_note: An employee whose average daily wage is this or less pays no employee share; the employer share is still due.
contribution_period_note: Coverage is decided on the monthly gross; an employee covered in a contribution period (Apr-Sep, Oct-Mar) stays covered to its end even if the wage rises above the ceiling.
wages_exclude_note: Not ESI wages: reimbursements, travelling allowance, gratuity, encashment on exit, refunds, annual bonus. Overtime and incentives ARE wages for the contribution.
